$comment: PERSONAL file, git-ignored, one per project at apiTest.configFile. Each project fills its own URLs and login info. Tokens are captured from a browser login and saved by save-token.ps1 — never typed into chat.
$loginHelp: tokenFrom: localStorage | sessionStorage | header. tokenKey: the storage key (or a JSON key path like 'oidc.user:https://idp:client.access_token'). Leave both empty the first time: the api-test skill detects them and fills them in.

auth.$comment: OPTIONAL. Only for projects whose identity server allows password/client_credentials grants (used by get-token.ps1). Most SPA logins do not — leave empty and use the browser login.
